title: Share a WIP protocol with a private group
author: Adrien Assie
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.qzhdx36
materials: Edit name, descriptions, authors, tags and keywords. a

steps.title: Create a new protocol
steps.instruction: Initiate the creation of a new protocol by clicking the + sign located in the upper right corner of the screen.

steps.title: Add protocol description and guidelines
steps.instruction: Fill in the 'Description' and 'Guidelines and warnings' boxes.

steps.title: Define materials and reagents
steps.instruction: Fill the 'Materials' box by searching for reagents in the database or adding new ones using the 'Add new' button.

steps.title: Construct protocol steps
steps.instruction: Add steps to the protocol either by importing from a text file or by clicking 'New Step'.

substeps.instruction: Add graphics to steps as required.

steps.title: Finalize or share protocol
steps.instruction: Determine if the protocol is final for publishing or if it needs to be shared privately with a group.

steps.title: Share protocol via the share menu
steps.instruction: Use the share menu to distribute the protocol to a specific group.

substeps.instruction: Type the group name in the 'Start typing group name' box.
Select the identified private group and click 'save'.

steps.title: Share protocol via My Library
steps.instruction: Alternatively, share the protocol by dragging it from your files to a group.

substeps.instruction: Click 'My library' in the top right corner.
Select the protocol and drag it to the desired private group (e.g., Samuel Lab).
